question: **Which of the following qualities would you find in a robot?**
solution:
The correct sentence is "**Precision**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the third sentence of the passage, it is mentioned that "unlike robots, we human beings have feelings, emotions, and dreams".
 
• in the above-mentioned sentence, we can see that **dreams, feelings, and emotions **are the qualities attributed to human beings.
 
• **Options 1, 2, and 3** are all elements that are attributed to **human beings**.
 
• As robots are in contrast to humans, only **precision** can be attributed to robots.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
